newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $1.506 bln in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $1.506 bln in Aug.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $1.506 billion in August in the forex commercial market, against a $1.933 billion surplus in July, bankers said.
Financial buy operations totaled $4.861 billion in August, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $4.189 billion last month.
Dealers said August contracted exports were $4.534 billion against $3.700 billion in import operations.
